capabilities: Render clickable \ref, \eqref, and \cite links in Live Preview and Reading view without modifying the file
Jump to labels in the current note or another note
Number labelled equation and figure environments and Markdown headings
Complete label and citation keys while typing
Report unresolved references, missing citation keys, and duplicate or invalid labels
disambiguation: Not a general LaTeX engine or BibTeX style processor; figure layout options are ignored and bibliography formatting is numeric and lightweight.
extras: README notes the initial implementation was AI-assisted (OpenAI GPT-5.6 via Codex) with the maintainer responsible; it states the plugin makes no network requests or telemetry, and documents known limitations such as one labelled equation environment per display-math block.
problem: Obsidian has no native support for LaTeX cross-references, equation/figure numbering, or BibTeX citations, and converting notes to LaTeX usually means rewriting the source.

relations.evidence: Its architecture was informed by Equation Ordinal and Cite, both MIT-licensed Obsidian plugins.

summary: Renders and navigates LaTeX \label, \ref, \eqref, and \cite commands in Markdown while leaving the source file portable LaTeX.
